symptom: `describe microflow SnowflakeRESTSQL.GET_v1_RetrievePartition` (Evora): the REST call's handler (401 + $Retry → set $Retry = false → back to the loop header to regenerate the token) loses `set $Retry = false` and the way back: `if $Retry then` comes out EMPTY, so re-executed the retry is a fall-through. Once fixed, its description failed check with `merge rejoin1: nothing joins it` (MDL-FLOW02)
cause: The handler's path runs through ExclusiveMerges with ONE incoming flow (no-ops Studio Pro leaves behind). firstReachableErrorHandlerMerge settled on the first of them as the handler's stop, and the handler walk stops at any merge — unlabelled, so nothing was emitted after it. Check: the label walk read handler bodies via getErrorHandlerBody, which does not list RestCallStmt (and ~10 other types statementErrorHandling knows), and walked every `while` as a loop activity although `while true` around a return is a merge + back-edge in the enclosing graph
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_show_merge.go` (firstMergeFrom skips isNoOpMerge; incomingCounts), `cmd_microflows_show_helpers.go` (handler walk + firstReachableErrorHandlerMerge walk through no-op merges), `validate_microflow_merge_join.go` (handlerBodyForLabels via statementErrorHandling; manual `while true` walked as top level)
insight: A merge with one way in is not a join point; every search for 'where does this handler rejoin' must look past it, or the label decision and the walk disagree with the graph. getErrorHandlerBody (validate.go) is a drifted duplicate of the builder's statementErrorHandling — it misses RestCall, Commit, Delete, SendRestRequest, CallExternalAction, import/export mapping, TransformJson — so anything walking handler bodies with it is blind there (left alone here: other open PRs touch it). Two traverse tests modelled a rejoin merge with only the handler's flow into it; given the main path's flow too they keep their meaning. Guards `TestDescribeHandlerRetry_*`, `TestCheckMergeJoin_*`, repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/describe-irreducible-handler-noop-merge.mdl`
